text:
ana: Repro: streaming upload in sampleapp fails when server does multi-host redirect (307 -> 302). Seen on Pixel emulator Android 14 and a Pixel 6 device.

tim: what failure? 401 or broken stream?

ana: 401 from storage host. Initial request has Authorization, second hop doesn't. Streaming RequestBody aborted because we can't rewind FileInputStream.

rachel: OkHttp strips sensitive headers when host changes on redirect. Two options: Authenticator (but only runs on 401/407) or manual redirect handling.

tim: manual follow requires rewinding or buffering the body. For demo we buffer small files into memory (<=2MB) and error above that. Not ideal for large uploads.

ana: we tried followRedirects(false) + manual follow: new Request.Builder().headers(orig.headers) then POST to new URL. Works but clunky.

rachel: note for SDK parity: sampleapp currently only shows header auth. Let's add a TokenAuthenticator snippet and a short note about redirect semantics in the Android guide.

tim: also add guidance recommending signed upload URLs for streaming uploads — avoids auth header issues entirely.

qa-bot: created ticket DEVEX-7200 to track: "multi-host redirect drops auth for streaming uploads - add samples/docs and CI test"

ana: will open a tiny PR: Authenticator example + manual-redirect helper + short doc blurb. Keep examples minimal to avoid onboarding friction.

rachel: also add a quick CI e2e with MockWebServer simulating 307->302 and assert behavior on emulator.

tim: one more parity note: okhttp 4.x vs 5.x differ on default header retention for cross-host redirects. Add to migration docs.

ana: thanks all — posting follow-up after PR. :thumbsup:
